div.div:
Read this as the template, not as one service. Every bounded-context page that follows is this picture with real names filled in.
No service calls another service over HTTP or gRPC. The one synchronous exception is direct Lambda invocation where the call is synchronous by nature (Payment → PaymentGateway) — never between contexts that could wait for an event instead.
An event is never published by the handler that wrote the item. The write commits first, DynamoDB Streams captures it, and a dedicated publisher Lambda emits it (ADR-0005) — so a published event is, by construction, something that really happened.
Every publisher and consumer has an SQS dead-letter queue with an alarm (ADR-0015); omitted here for clarity — each context page draws its own.
